title: Fish the Dead Projects
intro: Cast into the crypto graveyard and reel up dead chains, rugged tokens and abandoned projects.
castHint: Hold to power up, let go to cast. Longer casts find rarer catches.
tooEarly: Too early! You scared it off.
snapped: The line slipped. It got away.

lesson: Most of these promised big returns with little risk. If it sounds too good to be true, it usually is.
boxLine: Every catch you have ever landed. Can you collect them all?
